combo_label: The Human Body × Sailing & Boats × Winnie-the-Pooh

entries.clue: Plumpness; a bear's morning exercises before the glass were named for it.
White river bird that carried the bear's short name before the bear did.
Click of mild reproof; doubled, what a bear had the boy say about rain.
Huge balloon of light nylon bellied out ahead when the wind is behind
Shinbone: the thicker of the two bones in the lower leg.
Biggest workhorse in a yacht's wardrobe of canvas, hoisted up the tallest spar
Tough cord fastening flesh to the skeleton.
Grand name a boy gave the beetle he found, in a 1927 verse.
Natural coating the outer canal makes to trap dust and grit.
Rough rattling sound that comes from a sleeper
Twin-hulled craft that skims along flat instead of leaning over
Cabins so described are the ones nearest the stern, farthest from the bow
Rise of ground; a verse wonders where the wind that crosses one goes.
